projects.project_name: Manila Metro Line 1 Cavite Extension (Baclaran - Niog, Bacoor) (a.k.a LRT 1 Cavite Extension Project)
projects.project_description:
11.7 km new railway line from its tie in point at the terminus of LRT Line 1 at the Baclaran Terminal to Niyog Station at Bacoor, Cavite, of which approximately 10.5 km will be elevated and 1.2 km will be at-grade. Eight (8) stations will be constructed with a provision for 2 additional stations. Intermodal facilities will also be installed at high-demand stations, namely Niyog, Zapote, and Dr. Santos Stations. It also includes the procurement of 30, 4-car trains or 120 light rail vehicles.
